result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major untranslated section title is shown as a raw localization key, and the right-edge content is partially clipped in horizontal lists.

issues.description: A section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing localization/resource mapping so the heading renders translated copy such as "Popular near you"; add a fallback string and QA check for unresolved keys.

issues.description: Horizontal carousel content is clipped at the right edge, including a category chip after "Healthy" and the "Trattoria Piccol..." restaurant card title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure peeking/cutoff is intentional and consistent; otherwise adjust padding, card widths, and truncation so off-screen items are clearly indicated without awkward text clipping.
